```py
import rasterio
import numpy as np

# Define the years of interest
years = [1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020]

# Initialize list to store annual residential volume totals
annual_residential_volumes = []

for year in years:
    # Construct file paths for total and non-residential built volume
    total_path = f"/data1/yuhongjie2/terrabox/data/earthbench/question_data/question187/Shanghai_built_volume_total_{year}-01-01.tif"
    nres_path = f"/data1/yuhongjie2/terrabox/data/earthbench/question_data/question187/Shanghai_built_volume_nres_{year}-01-01.tif"

    # Open and read rasters
    with rasterio.open(total_path) as src_total:
        total_data = src_total.read(1)
    with rasterio.open(nres_path) as src_nres:
        nres_data = src_nres.read(1)

    # Calculate residential volume (pixel-wise subtraction)
    residential_data = total_data - nres_data

    # Calculate total residential volume for the year (sum of all pixels)
    annual_total = np.nansum(residential_data)
    annual_residential_volumes.append(annual_total)

# Now perform linear trend analysis on annual_residential_volumes
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import coint
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Compute linear trend using least squares
x = np.arange(len(annual_residential_volumes))  # Years since first observation
y = annual_residential_volumes

# Calculate slope (trend) and intercept
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

# Output results
print(f"Linear trend: Slope = {slope:.2f} (annual change), Intercept = {intercept:.2f}")
print(f"Equation: Residential Volume = {intercept:.2f} + {slope:.2f} * Year")

# Optional: Plot the trend
plt.plot(x, y, 'o', label='Data')
plt.plot(x, intercept + slope * x, 'r', label='Trend Line')
plt.legend()
plt.xlabel('Year Index')
plt.ylabel('Residential Volume')
plt.title('Residential Building Volume Trend in Shanghai (1985-2020)')
plt.show()
```
